items.title: MCHP Q2 Deep Dive: Data Center and Aerospace Demand Drive Growth, Margins Bolstered by Mix and Pricing
items.summary: Analog chipmaker Microchip Technology (NASDAQ:MCHP) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 38% year on year to $1.48 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($1.60 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 3.3% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.76 per share was 8.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Microchip Q1 Earnings Call Highlights Broad Recovery & Data Center Growth
items.summary: MCHP sees a broadening demand recovery, rising data center sales and another September step-up, even as external supply constraints tighten.

items.title: This Wall Street Pro Makes a Compelling Argument for 70% Gains on NXP Semiconductors Which Cratered Last Month
items.summary: A top Wall Street analyst slapped a Street-high price target on NXP Semiconductors just as the stock cratered 20% in a single month, and the gap between his conviction and the market's fear has rarely looked this wide in large-cap chips.

items.title: Why One Prominent Analyst Expects 85% Returns for ON Semiconductor Despite Current Turmoil
items.summary: ON Semiconductor just posted a clean earnings beat, yet its stock sits nearly 40% below its 52-week high while one top analyst sees a radically different story unfolding in the quarters ahead.
